title: Authorize CP11f Specialized relocation
goal: Pre-authorize the exact move, TCB and policy tuples required to relocate the Specialized gate package into the post-stage ownership boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: The move authorization binds the complete legacy and stage-owned Specialized trees.
The TCB authorization binds every changed trusted path to the affected trusted components.
The policy authorization binds all five semantic configuration changes.
The authorization-only change modifies no trusted implementation or active runtime path.
The relocation candidate consumes all three authorizations exactly once.
